::: {.home-hero-text}

I’m a PhD candidate in the Department of Physics at [Khalifa University](https://www.ku.ac.ae/), Abu Dhabi, working with Dr. Satyendra Thoudam on the origin and propagation of Galactic cosmic rays.

My research focuses on Bayesian modeling and numerical simulations of cosmic-ray transport, combining data from space- and ground-based experiments. I’m broadly interested in astroparticle physics, high-energy astrophysics, and multi-messenger astronomy.
